description: This file is a PHP class definition for the Controller of Category management in the admin section of OpenCart. It includes methods for listing, viewing, editing, and managing categories via an MVC pattern, and handles rendering views, processing requests, and interacting with models.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class for managing categories in the admin panel of OpenCart, extending the base Controller class and providing CRUD and listing functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the category list page with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of categories as an output, typically in response to a request.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Protected method that gathers filter, sort, pagination data, calls the model for categories, and returns the rendered view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a category, including loading scripts and pre-filling data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated category data based on form submission.
